title: 8 Adaptive / Risk-Based Authentication Tools: Our Top Picks by Use Case (2026)
content_md: Quick Answer: Adaptive authentication splits into a workforce lane and a fraud lane buy them separately. Workforce: Microsoft Conditional Access (bundled policy engine for M365 estates), Cisco Duo Risk-Based (fastest independent deployment), Okta Adaptive MFA (mixed-SaaS estates), Ping (orchestrated enterprise risk). Fraud/consumer: LexisNexis ThreatMetrix’s device-network intelligence and IBM Trusteer for banking channels. HYPR pairs risk with passwordless; miniOrange covers the value tier. Risk signals now decide when to challenge; passkeys decide how . Who This Guide Is For Security teams tired of MFA-prompting everyone for everything, fraud leaders scoring logins against global device intelligence, and architects designing step-up policies for high-value actions. Eight picks organized by lane and estate because a workforce Conditional Access policy and a banking fraud engine share a name but not a buyer. Adapting verification based on risk signals is key to neutralizing tactics like AiTM reverse proxy attacks . How We Selected (Our Method) Research-based: documented risk-signal breadth (device, network, behavior, threat intel), policy expressiveness, passkey integration, pricing structure, and deployment evidence. Evaluating capabilities alongside leading Zero Trust security platforms ensures each tool aligns with modern architecture standards. No paid placement, no vendor pre-review, no lab-test claims. Unconfirmed items carry. The Eight Picks, Organized by Lane Workforc
